free_text: The statistical prior suggested biopsy (p=0.76) and its 'firm' tier was not contradicted by the retrieved evidence. The evidence strongly supports sampling because the rising PSA trend (4.2 to 13.5 ng/mL) combined with the new PI-RADS 5 finding contradicts the prior low-grade diagnosis of Gleason 3+3. The conference converged on biopsy because the retrieved documents showed progression indicators that warranted further tissue sampling.
